scope: Bounded synthetic state-based diagnostic; no VLA, learning or formal guarantee
research_question: Does ego-route change interact with reactive ORCA humans to create additional transient miscoverage/risk after controlling for actuation delay and simple margins/wait?

event.switch: At tick40 change (2,2) to (2,-2); same final goal (12,0)
event.prefix: Same world, predictor, calibrator, controller and RNG snapshot within method/reaction/delay before branching
event.boundary: Remaining route lengths may differ at fork. Log both and do not infer calibration mediation from interaction alone.

splits.generator: Four crossing lines around origin with staggered arrival, angular-band and seed holdout
splits.generalization_boundary: Parameter-band holdout in one topology/ORCA model, not semantic family or cross-environment generalization

execution.calibrator_rng: SHA256 named streams as P3; cloned before hold/switch

methods.M0: fixed episode-balanced empirical 90% residual quantile per horizon from calibration split
methods.M1: P3 timestamp-aware DtACI initialized to same estimated radii
methods.M2: P3 rolling empirical quantile, same initial radii; seed with 24 per-episode 90% residual quantiles for warm start
methods.M3: M0 radii plus P3 stop/wait/hysteresis; no tuning
methods.boundary: M2 warm start uses one calibration summary per episode, then appends online residuals; no finite-sample/mission certificate claimed

calibration.reference_controller: P3 M0 with original fixed fixture radii, no tuning
calibration.radius_estimator: Weighted empirical 90th quantile of matured residuals; each episode has total weight 1, within-episode residuals equal weight. Horizons separate.
calibration.sample_unit: episodes; correlated frames not independent statistical samples
calibration.guarantee: NONE; adaptive deployment, dependent data and changed scene parameters violate naive calibration interpretation

gates.not_met_action: Write qualified negative/limited result; no extra test search, scene replacement, learning or automatic scale-up

metrics.primary_risk: Fraction of 20 post-event ticks with swept clearance <=0.25m; after collision fill remaining risk-window ticks with failure=1; after goal fill0 and log exposure.
metrics.collision: Any swept clearance<0 per episode and within post window; denominator includes all started branches and explicitly lists pre-event failures.
metrics.progress: Distance-to-final-goal reduction in [10,15]s; terminal position held, plus full final distance/time/path; voluntary wait reported separately
metrics.coverage: Per-episode per-horizon mean uncovered among matured valid targets in [5,10) and [10,15); report available/invalid/right-censored denominators, never zero-fill unobserved labels
other: no-progress: <0.1m displacement over any5s window while >0.5m from goal
human effect NOT_MEASURED without separate no-ego reference

analysis.interaction: (reactive switch-hold)-(nonreactive switch-hold), per method/delay, paired by scene; also unreactive switch cost and raw pre/post changes
analysis.coverage_interaction: Interaction in post-minus-pre miscoverage for each horizon, with H=5 predeclared diagnostic focus; no pooled independent-frame CI
analysis.risk_floor: Report count of episodes with any post near-risk/collision; all-zero risk cannot establish a safety gain
analysis.uncertainty: Scene-cluster percentile bootstrap 1000 resamples seed95001; n<=12, descriptive, not confirmatory significance
analysis.shadow: On M0 executed observation streams, run all four forecast/calibrator states with same observations. Shadow M3 forecasts equal M0; no shadow deployment claim.
analysis.continue_rule: Only if no-delay M1 has positive transient risk interaction >=0.05 AND H5 miscoverage-change interaction >=0.05, at least9 complete paired scenes, and pattern not eliminated by M0, M2 or M3 at matched progress (within0.5m) and risk tolerance0.02; even then diagnostic REVISE, not method GO.
analysis.alternative_rule: If only delayed cells show pattern: delay-specific REVISE. If all risk zero or labels/cells insufficient: INCONCLUSIVE/HOLD. If fixed margin or wait explains pattern: reject new-method justification in this pilot.
analysis.threshold_boundary: Thresholds are local smallest-practical-effect screening choices, not universal scientific constants or p-values; freeze before test.
analysis.simple_explanation_rule: For each baseline M0/M2/M3 at the same delay, compare reactive-switch branches paired by scene: at least9 pairs, absolute mean progress difference vs M1 <=0.5m, mean risk difference <=0.02, and baseline joint risk/coverage interaction fails the two0.05 thresholds. This is a descriptive screen, not equivalence or mediation proof.

runtime_qualified: P3 passes; P4-specific boundary checks required before pilot
